description: Direct media access settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.DirectMediaConfig.

enabled.description: Enable direct media access via federation-style media endpoints.

server_name.description: Server name for the media proxy (inlined from mediaproxy.BasicConfig).

server_key.description: Signing key for federation. Set to 'generate' for auto-generation.

well_known_response.description: Custom .well-known response for the media server.

allow_proxy.description: Allow proxying media through the homeserver if direct download fails.
